observations: Black plastic engine cover or valve cover on a metal engine component
Multi-colored wires (red, yellow, blue, green) connected to an electrical plug
Metal engine block or cylinder head visible around and beneath the cover
Watermark text "FAMOUS AUTO PARTS" across the center of the image
Used condition with dirt, grime, and surface corrosion
No readable brand, model, or part number visible on the item itself

claims.evidence: Seller's words only; not shown or proven in the photo

risks.risk: The part may be cracked, internally damaged, or non-functional
risks.proof: Video of the part installed and running, or a compression/leak-down test, or clear photos of all mating faces and internal surfaces

risks.risk: The part may not fit the buyer's vehicle (wrong make, model, or year)
risks.proof: Photo of casting number, part number, or stamp on the metal, or statement of the vehicle it was removed from

risks.risk: The part may be incomplete (missing sensors, bolts, gaskets, or connectors)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included components and accessories laid out together

proof_requests: Show any casting numbers, part numbers, or stamps on the metal
State which car make, model, and year it was removed from
Provide a video of the engine running or a compression test if it is an engine assembly
response.reason: The item is a used car engine part, but no brand, model, or vehicle fitment is visible in the photo, and engine-part prices depend entirely on the specific application; even a worst-case price cannot be set without knowing what it fits.
